symbols.name: PARTS
symbols.role: Defines active part IDs, names, categories, tags and design sizes.

symbols.name: SPRITES
symbols.role: Maps part IDs to 4x4 sprite-sheet cells.

symbols.name: SPRITE_SHEETS
symbols.role: Maps numeric sheet keys to source files.

symbols.name: PART_IMAGE_ASSETS
symbols.role: Maps part IDs to individual PNG files and overrides SPRITES at runtime.

symbols.name: spriteStyle
symbols.role: Selects individual PNG first; otherwise renders a 4x4 sprite cell. The two paths currently align differently.

symbols.name: RecoloredPartArt
symbols.role: Uses the same individual-first source priority for recoloring.

symbols.name: assembleParts
symbols.role: Applies runtime category placement, sizing, layering and rear-tool flip behavior.

finding: Runtime currently has two alignment paths: individual PNG uses centered contain while sprite cells use atlas positioning. Phase one records this and does not alter gameplay code.
